title: The free mobile centre pawn

D0.outcome: Explains that an enemy mobile centre pawn is either removed by a prepared break or restrained until it is weak.

D1.outcome: Chooses between the quick kill (prepared break) and restraint (piece set-up) for a given free centre pawn.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, picks the break or set-up and rejects a premature break.

D3.outcome: Predicts why a rushed break fails and what the restraint set-up costs.

misconceptions: The enemy centre pawn must be captured at once.
The centre must always be held by pawns.
conditions: After a centre exchange the opponent keeps a pawn on e4 or d4 against a restrained set-up.
Restraint is hard; the quick kill is rarely available.
contrasts: A premature break against the mobile pawn.
Holding the centre with pieces when a counterbalancing disadvantage appears.
